title: Promotion

D0.outcome: Says that a pawn reaching the last rank must become a queen, rook, bishop or knight, never a king or a pawn.

D1.outcome: Promotes a pawn to a queen when told, and capture-promotes when straight ahead is blocked.

D2.outcome: Decides whether a pawn can promote on this move, straight ahead or by capture.

D3.outcome: Chooses a promotion other than the queen when the queen would stalemate in a won ending, or when another piece gives checkmate.

misconceptions: A pawn must always become a queen.
You can only promote to a piece you have lost.
A pawn can become a king.
conditions: A pawn reaching the last rank becomes a queen, rook, bishop or knight at once, as part of the move.
The queen is usually best, but check whether the promotion gives stalemate or whether another piece gives checkmate.
contrasts: Promoting to a queen can stalemate the enemy king where a rook would win.
The pieces you already have do not limit what you may promote to.
